notes.subject: ol god bilong yu
notes.rationale: אלהיך plural: 'ol god' (KJV) vs 'wanpela god' (JPS) — tok Hebrev i stap long plural, olsem na mi holim plural.

notes.subject: nul bilong kot
notes.rationale: חרט: 'graving tool' o 'kapsaitim long mould' (LXX/Sam 'bəḥerit' 'long mould') — mi bihainimMasoretik.

notes.subject: samting ol i kapsaitim gol i wokim
notes.rationale: מסכה 'samting ol i kapsaitim gol i wokim' — molten image, TPI i no gat wanpela tok bilong en.

notes.subject: to Yisrael
notes.rationale: Tok direk long Yisrael: 'ol god bilong yu, Yisrael'.

translation: Na em i kisim long ol han bilong ol, na em i wokim ⟨את⟩ em wantaim nul bilong kot, na em i mekim em i kamap pikinini bulmakau, samting ol i kapsaitim gol i wokim; na ol i tok: Dispela ol god bilong yu, Yisrael, ol i kirapim yu i go aut long graun bilong Mitsrayim.

tokens.gloss: samting ol i kapsaitim gol i wokim
